resourcesGuide.title: How Cloud usage works
resourcesGuide.creditsHint: Builds and running apps use credits for CPU, memory, disk activity and data transfer. Larger workloads use credits faster.
resourcesGuide.buildHint: Time spent building your code. A 5-minute build uses 5 build minutes. Build resources also use Cloud credits.
resourcesGuide.appsHint: Apps, databases and workers running at the same time. Each running Compose service counts toward this limit.
resourcesGuide.machineHint: The largest CPU and memory size available for one service. This is a limit, not a shared balance.
resourcesGuide.projectsHint: Projects saved in your workspace, including drafts.
resourcesGuide.routesHint: Public Cloud addresses for your apps.
resourcesGuide.setupHint: Cloud builds and running apps require a paid plan. No free Cloud compute is included.
resourcesGuide.limitsHint: Plan limits and credits are separate. Deployments need both available capacity and credits.
resourcesGuide.balanceRule: Cloud workloads pause when credits run out. Adding credits replenishes your balance; a larger plan raises your resource limits.
resourcesGuide.cpuHint: Processing used over time. 1 vCPU running for 1 hour is 1 vCPU-hour.
resourcesGuide.memoryHint: Memory used over time. 1 GB for 1 hour is 1 GB-hour.
resourcesGuide.diskHint: Data read and written by your apps. This is disk activity, not stored disk size.
resourcesGuide.networkHint: Data sent and received by your apps.
resourcesGuide.selectedRange: Credits used in this date range
resourcesGuide.usageHint: Actual resource usage for the selected dates. Total Cloud credits are shown above.
resourcesGuide.invalidRange: Choose an end date on or after the start date.
